name: hermes_codex_rate_limited_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: HERMES_CODEX_RATE_LIMITED_20261107 — 2026-11-06 live: hermes-deep-research-local.service failed every
tick (22:00-05:35 ET) with CODEX_HEADLESS_UNAVAILABLE 'authed but did not finalize a response — re-login',
three targets per tick, exit 1, row graded RUN_FAILED. The OAuth proxy at :8646 was up and authenticated with
last_upstream.state=rate_limited: the proxy's 429 was swallowed by _call_codex_proxy's bare except, the CLI
fallback (same OAuth session) was attempted, and a quota condition was reported as an auth failure.
Fix: scripts/hermes_external_researcher.py raises CodexRateLimited on a 429 (or an empty answer while the
proxy reports rate_limited), call_codex_cli re-raises CODEX_UNAVAILABLE_RATE_LIMITED without attempting the
CLI. The message keeps the UNAVAILABLE token on purpose so the lane's status classifier still records a
lane-level failure ('unavailable'), not 'error'. Hermetic: fake requests module, synthetic proxy bodies, the
CLI entry point forbidden by an AssertionError, no network, no credential, no live lane.
